description: NaInP₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one InO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.66 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.61 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one In and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom.
